Lint a wiki page

This tutorial is for an agent or a person who writes wiki pages in sieun-pi. At the end you will have run the prose lint on a draft, read its findings and fixed one of them.

Before you start

  • You have the sieun-pi checkout at /home/sieun/src/sieun-pi.
  • You have Node 22 or later on your path.

Run the lint

  1. Save your draft as an HTML file, then run the lint on it from the checkout.

    node apps/wiki/scripts/prose-lint.mjs draft.html

    The lint prints one line for each finding, with its rule and a fix.

    draft.html:12 error em-dash: End the sentence or use a comma.

  2. Open the draft at the line the finding names, and replace the dash with a comma.

    sed -n 12p draft.html

Check it worked

Run the lint again. It prints no findings and exits with code 0.

node apps/wiki/scripts/prose-lint.mjs draft.html; echo $?
0

When it goes wrong

If the lint prints skipped, the file is markdown. The lint reads HTML only, so save the draft as HTML and run it again.
